recommended_reframe: Claim volume climbs steadily with industry-payment decile (2-4x from unpaid to top decile), but brand-name claim share does not track it the same way -- in Cardiology brand share is flat or even below the no-payment baseline from D01 through D07 and only jumps in the top decile, so the earlier claim of a steady, specialty-wide monotonic brand-share gradient is not supported once volume is accounted for.
